headline: Small, private apps for iPhone
intro: B&N Software is an independent app studio in Nitra, Slovakia. Our apps each do one thing well, work offline and keep your data on your iPhone.
about: B&N Software s. r. o. is a software company registered in Slovakia. We design, build and publish our own apps for iPhone and support them ourselves.

Everything we make follows the same rules: no accounts, no ads, no analytics and no tracking. Your data stays on your device, and the core features of every app are free. Optional Pro features are sold through the App Store.
